  **Added by browser test 2026-08-10 — a second, independent bug in the same files: the canonical page is empty on first visit too, from a race.** `useLinkedDevices.ts:71-78` fires `supabase.functions.invoke("device-register", …)` **un-awaited** and calls `fetchDevices()` on the next line, so the SELECT resolves before the INSERT lands. Reproduced signed in as a real account: `/account/linked-devices` rendered "No devices recorded yet", and an immediate reload rendered "ACTIVE NOW — Mac · This device · Active 1 minute ago". So a user who visits once, sees nothing, and never returns concludes no devices are linked — while `/devices` separately reports "SIGNED IN · 0 devices" on the very device they are signed in on. Fix both in one pass: `await` the registration (or refetch on its resolution) before the first fetch, and have the failure surface rather than being swallowed by `void`. Worth a contract asserting registration is awaited ahead of the initial read, since this is invisible to any test that only mounts once with a pre-populated table.

Direct table writes are RLS-blocked — do not attempt them. Keep the localStorage copy as an offline fallback but stop presenting it as the source of truth; `src/test/parentalSafetyServerGate.test.ts` pins that the page must not claim server backing until this lands (update that assertion when wiring). **Same claim, second half:** two-step still gates nothing at sign-in (re-verified 2026-08-10 — `two_step_auth` has settings pages but no login-path reader), so `TwoStepAuthPage`/`PrivacySecurityPage` copy must stop implying it protects sign-in until a real challenge exists; that challenge is an auth-flow design decision, not a drive-by. _(frontend claimed by @codex, 2026-08-10)_

- **PriceAlertWidget — optimistic-UI false-success fix (toggle + remove price alerts)** (`src/components/shared/PriceAlertWidget.tsx`, `toggleAlert` ~L79 + `removeAlert` ~L88) — same false-success family as the social/Build-RO slices, on a shared travel widget's two per-row controls (the active/inactive **toggle switch** and the **remove** button). The bug: each handler did an **optimistic `setAlerts(...)`** then a **bare unchecked** `await supabase.from("price_alerts").update(...).eq("id", id)` then an **unconditional** `toast.success(...)`. A supabase-js `.update()` **resolves with `{ data, error }` even when the DB rejects** the write (RLS denial / offline / constraint) — it does NOT throw unless you inspect `error` or call `.throwOnError()`. So on a rejected write the user saw the row flip (or vanish) **plus** a green "Alert updated" / "Alert removed" toast, while the DB kept the old value — and the row **silently reverted on the next refetch/page-load**, with zero feedback. `toggleAlert` lied about the on/off state; `removeAlert` (a soft-delete `update({ is_active: false })` that the UI filters out of the list) lied about removal. Fix (additive, 2 hunks, App-logic only, happy path byte-identical): destructure `const { error } = await …update(…)`; **on `error`, roll back the optimistic state and surface it** — `toggleAlert` restores the pre-toggle `alert.isActive` (captured before the optimistic flip) and toasts `"Couldn't update alert"`; `removeAlert` snapshots `const prevAlerts = alerts` at the top (before the optimistic filter) and restores it, toasting `"Couldn't remove alert"`; both `return` early so the success toast **only** fires when `error` is null. `toast` is already imported from sonner (so `toast.error` needs no new import). **Advisors — both reviewed the exact before/after and converged "correct and minimal, ship it":** DeepSeek (`deepseek-chat` via MCP) → *"eliminates the false-success defect with correct rollback logic. Ship it."* — confirmed BEFORE is a real false-success defect, the rollback is correct with **no stale-closure pitfall** (both handlers capture the pre-mutation value/array synchronously before the optimistic `setAlerts`), and the shape is minimal. MiMo (`mimo-v2.5-pro`, `--file /tmp/zivomedia-pricealert-41.tsx`; run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T14-25-37-review-a-false-success-fix-in-a-client-only-vite-r-mimo.md`) → *"correct and minimal. Ship it."* — same control-flow verification, same no-stale-closure confirmation. **Deferred — MiMo flagged these as PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by this fix), out of scope for this false-success pass:** (a) **no double-submit guard** — a rapid second click while the first request is in-flight could clobber the rollback snapshot (same shape as `FollowSuggestions` before its `pending` guard); a `saving`/`pending` guard + `disabled` is the standard follow-up; (b) **`removeAlert` 0-row match** — if the alert was already removed by another tab/device the soft-delete matches 0 rows and returns `{ error: null }`, a harmless **no-op success** (not a false-success), worth noting as future hardening. **Sibling follow-up (verified, documented not fixed this slice):** `src/components/rides/SmartSavedPlaces.tsx` `removePlace` (~L97) has the **identical** unguarded-`delete()`-then-unconditional-`toast.success("Place removed")` pattern (and that file's own `addPlace` already does the correct `if (!error && data)` check — proving the pattern is known there) → flagged for a future slice to keep this one single-file and crisply verifiable. Verified: `npm run update` green (type-check + worker type-check + production build + PWA, true exit 0, zero TS errors). The error branch only manifests on a forced DB rejection (can't trigger without breaking RLS), and the happy path is unchanged, so it rests on the green type-check + dual-advisor review of the exact diff; not exercised in the live preview (the failure path needs a real write rejection). No live Supabase writes fired. Touches the 1 file only (2 hunks). Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Auto-repair Build-RO — `copyApprovalLink` false-success dead-share-link fix** (`src/components/admin/store/autorepair/AutoRepairBuildROSection.tsx`, `copyApprovalLink` ~L1617) — same false-success family already shipped on the **sibling repo zivosoftware as #32** (these AutoRepairBuildROSection files are sibling copies; #32 only touched zivosoftware, leaving zivosmedia's copy carrying the identical bug). The "Copy approval link" handler mints a public share token so a customer can open `/estimate/:token` (a **public** page that resolves the row via the RPC `ar_get_estimate_by_share_token`). The first-share branch (`if (!token)`) generated a UUID and then did a **bare unchecked write**: `await supabase.from("ar_estimates").update({ share_token: token, status: "sent" }).eq("id", id)`. A supabase-js update **resolves with `{ data, error }` even when the DB rejects** the write (RLS denial / offline / constraint) — it does NOT throw unless you inspect `error` or call `.throwOnError()`. So when the token-save failed silently, control fell straight through to building the url + `setStatus("sent")` + `toast.success("Approval link copied")`. The customer then opened `/estimate/:token`, the public page found **no row** with that share_token (it was never persisted), and the operator had reported success on a **dead customer link**. Fix (additive, 1 hunk, App-logic only): destructure `const { error } = await …update(…)` and `if (error) throw error;` so a rejected token-save routes into the function's **existing outer** `catch (e: any) => toast.error(e?.message ?? "Failed")` instead of the false success. Both happy paths are untouched: existing token → skip the write → copy; successful first-share write → `error` null → throw skipped → copy. **Advisors — both reviewed the exact diff and converged "clean / ship it":** DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP) → *"The fix is correct"* (confirmed the guard closes the dead-link path, happy path preserved, a now-surfaced transient error is strictly more correct since the prior "success" was a dead link). MiMo (`mimo-v2.5-pro`; run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T13-22-20-false-success-silent-supabase-write-review-of-a-cl-mimo.md`) → *"The fix is clean"* with a full 3-path trace confirming the throw sits exactly in the single write→url-build gap the bug exploited, and that on retry the `select` re-reads `share_token: null` (the rejected write persisted nothing) and mints a fresh UUID — **no stuck state, no stale token** (the function has no `saving` flag, so the button is immediately re-clickable after the error toast). **Deferred — both advisors flagged these as PRE-EXISTING (not introduced by this fix), out of scope for this false-success pass:** (a) **double-submit race** — two rapid clicks both read `token: null`, mint different UUIDs, last write wins → the first caller's URL goes dead; standard fix is a `saving` guard + `disabled` button (the original bare write had this same race); (b) **0-row update match** — if the row were deleted between `ensureSavedId()` and the update, `.eq("id", id)` matches 0 rows → `{ error: null }` → dead link; `ensureSavedId()` is contractually supposed to guarantee the row exists; (c) **`status:"sent"` not re-set on the skip branch** — acceptable: the local `setStatus("sent")` still runs after the `if (!token)` block, and the DB status was already set `"sent"` on the first share; (d) the **6 sibling Type-B duplicate-on-retry sites** in the same file (L1332 `converted_workorder_id`, L1389 `converted_invoice_id`, L1545, L1604) still need the #26 forward-guard treatment — a separate slice. Verified: `npm run update` green (type-check + worker + build + PWA, true exit 0, zero TS errors). The silent-failure path itself only manifests on a forced DB rejection (can't trigger without breaking RLS), so it rests on the green type-check + dual-advisor review of the exact diff. No live Supabase writes fired. Touches the 1 file only (1 hunk). Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Social Follow controls — silent write-failure + double-submit fix (FollowSuggestions, FeaturedCreatorsRow)** (`src/components/social/FollowSuggestions.tsx` + `src/components/social/FeaturedCreatorsRow.tsx`) — same silent-mutation-failure family as the social-pages entry below, in the two "Follow" surfaces of the home/social feed. A Supabase `.from("user_followers").insert()/.delete()` **resolves even when the DB rejects** (RLS / unique-violation on a duplicate follow / offline), so awaiting it without `.throwOnError()` or an `{ error }` check treats every failure as success. Two real defects: (1) **`FollowSuggestions.followUser`** awaited a bare `.insert({...})` then unconditionally `toast.success("Following!")` + `setDismissed()` (dropped the suggestion card) + fired a push notification — so a follow that never persisted still showed "Following!", removed the card, and **blocked retry** (the card was gone). (2) **`FeaturedCreatorsRow.handleFollow`** already had the right *shape* — a `pending` Set guard, an optimistic `setFollowingIds` toggle, a catch-with-rollback, and a `finally` clearing pending — but its `insert`/`delete` were **error-blind**, so the existing catch never fired on a DB rejection: the optimistic toggle stuck and no error toast appeared. Fix (additive, mirrors the repo's own correct `TrendingCreators.handleFollow` reference, which wraps `.insert({...}).throwOnError()` in try/catch with optimistic rollback + `toast.error`): (a) `FollowSuggestions.followUser` — wrapped the insert in try/catch + `.throwOnError()`; on failure it toasts `"Couldn't follow — please try again"` and **early-returns without dismissing the card or firing the false success toast/push**, so retry stays possible; (b) `FeaturedCreatorsRow` — appended `.throwOnError()` to **both** the insert and delete so the existing catch actually rolls back the optimistic `followingIds` and toasts. Also closed a real **double-submit** gap MiMo flagged in `FollowSuggestions` (the one surface still missing it; `FeaturedCreatorsRow` already had its `pending` Set): added a `pending: string[]` guard — `if (pending.includes(targetId)) return;` + `setPending(add)` at entry, cleared on the catch path and after the success dismiss, and `disabled={pending.includes(s.id)}` (+ `disabled:opacity-60`) on the Follow button — so a rapid double-tap can't fire a second insert that, post-fix, would hit the unique constraint and throw a confusing "Couldn't follow" toast right after the first tap already succeeded and dismissed the card. Advisors: **DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP)** + **MiMo (`npm run agent:mimo`)** both reviewed and converged — silent-failure was real; the `.throwOnError()` additions correctly route DB rejections into each (new/existing) catch; no double-toast (one toast per path), no lost optimistic state (rollback is symmetric), no type error (`as any` already bypasses the generated types and `.throwOnError()` is a valid runtime `PostgrestBuilder` method); MiMo's only finding was the missing `FollowSuggestions` double-submit guard, now closed (verified against the real file — `FeaturedCreatorsRow` did already have it). Verified: `npm run update` green (type-check + worker + build + PWA, true exit 0, zero TS errors). The silent-failure path only manifests on a forced DB rejection (can't trigger without breaking RLS), so it rests on the green type-check + dual-advisor review. Runs saved in `docs/agent-runs/`. No live Supabase writes fired. Touches the 2 component files only. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Social pages — silent write-failure / false-success fix (Communities, Events, Community detail)** (`src/pages/CommunitiesPage.tsx` + `src/pages/EventsPage.tsx` + `src/pages/CommunityDetailPage.tsx`) — the customer-facing social toggle actions (Join/Leave a community, RSVP/un-RSVP an event) and the community post-delete were lying on failure. The bug family: a Supabase `.from(t).delete()/.insert()` **resolves even when the DB rejects** (RLS / network) — you must read the returned `{ error }` and throw, else react-query treats the mutation as success and the `onSuccess` toast fires anyway. Concretely: (1) every toggle's **leave/un-RSVP `delete()` path swallowed the error** (`await …delete().eq().eq()` with no `{ error }` capture) → a failed Leave showed "Updated!" / failed un-RSVP showed "RSVP updated!" while the user was still a member/attendee; `CommunityDetailPage.joinMutation` was worst — **both** its delete AND insert paths swallowed errors, so even a failed Join toasted "Joined community!"; (2) **none of the four `useMutation`s had an `onError`**, so the paths that *did* throw (the insert/create paths) failed completely silently — no toast at all; (3) the inline post-delete (`onClick` on the trash button) did `await …delete(); toast.success("Post deleted")` with no error check → false "Post deleted" on a failed delete. Fix (additive, happy-path unchanged): made every `delete()` path symmetric with the existing insert paths (`const { error } = await …delete()…; if (error) throw error;`), added `onError: (e) => toast.error(e?.message ?? <fallback>)` to `joinMutation`/`rsvpMutation`/`createCommunity`/`createEvent`, and guarded the inline post-delete with an `{ error }` check + `toast.error` + early-return — exactly matching the file's own already-correct `handlePost` (`if (error) throw error` inside try/catch + `toast.error`), which was the reference pattern. Advisors: DeepSeek (MCP) + MiMo (`npm run agent:mimo`) both reviewed and approved the react-query idiom; both confirmed a `.delete()` matching 0 rows returns `{ error: null }`, so idempotent double-clicks won't spam false errors. MiMo flagged two things to check — verified both clean: **no `onMutate`** on any of the four mutations (no optimistic cache writes → the new `onError` needs no rollback), and **no wrapping `try/catch` at the call sites** (all invoked via fire-and-forget `.mutate()`; the only try/catch is around `handlePost` itself → no double-toast). Verified: `npm run update` green (type-check + worker + build + PWA, true exit 0, zero TS errors); both edited pages reloaded clean in the running dev preview (Communities + Events render with full header/tabs/empty-state, **zero console errors**). The silent-failure path itself only manifests on a forced DB rejection (can't trigger without breaking RLS), so it rests on the green type-check + advisor review + render-regression check. Runs saved in `docs/agent-runs/`. No live Supabase writes fired. Touches the 3 page files only. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Car-rental reservations — close-on-failure workflow-correctness fix** (`src/components/admin/store/car-rental/CarRentalReservationsSection.tsx` + `src/hooks/car-rental/useCarRentalReservations.ts`) — merchant booking admin. Both the Create and Edit reservation dialogs were closing **unconditionally** on submit, even when the save failed: `create()` returns `CarRentalReservation | null` (null on a recoverable 409 "vehicle already booked" / `CUSTOMER_BLOCKED` error) but the dialog ignored it, and the edit dialog closed via the parent regardless of outcome. On a recoverable error the operator lost all typed form data **and** the only error banner lived in the parent section, hidden behind the just-closed modal. Fix (additive, no behavior change on the happy path): (1) hook `update()` now returns `Promise<boolean>` (false after rollback-via-`load()`, true on success) — the `CheckoutSection` caller's bare `await update(...)` is unaffected; (2) `CreateReservationDialog` only closes when `onCreate` returns a row, gained an `error` prop + `submitted` guard (`useEffect(() => { if (open) setSubmitted(false); }, [open])` since it stays mounted) + an inline destructive banner so the operator sees *why* and can correct & retry without re-entering; (3) `EditReservationDialog` mirrors it (parent closes only `if (ok)`, inline banner; no reset effect needed — it remounts per `{editing && …}`). **MiMo shipped-verification caught a real latent bug I'd otherwise have shipped:** in `update()`'s error branch the message was set *before* `await load()`, but `load()` resets `error` to null on entry → the edit banner would render blank; fixed by setting the message *after* the refresh. Cancel/Refund dialogs share the same close-on-failure shape but were **deliberately deferred** (MiMo P2 — simpler reason/amount forms, far less data loss; fix when next touched). Advisors: MiMo via `scripts/agents/mimo-ask.mjs` — review run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T04-59-13-workflow-correctness-review-of-a-car-rental-merchant-booking-mimo.md` + shipped-verify run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T05-05-54-verify-the-shipped-implementation-of-a-close-on-failure-fix--mimo.md`; DeepSeek (MCP) was attempted twice but returned non-engaging boilerplate this session (unusable — review rests on MiMo + direct read). Verified `npm run update` green (type-check + worker + build) and `npx eslint` clean on both files. Pure logic/correctness pass — no live Supabase calls fired. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Car-rental reservations — close-on-failure slice 2 (Cancel + Refund + backdrop guard)** (`src/components/admin/store/car-rental/CarRentalReservationsSection.tsx` + `src/hooks/car-rental/useCarRentalReservations.ts`) — completes the slice-1 deferral and clears MiMo's two P2s. (1) **Close-on-failure for the Cancel + Refund dialogs.** `CancelReservationDialog` and `QuickRefundDialog` (the **financial** path — it records a refund) now mirror Create/Edit: each gained an `error` prop + `submitted` guard + inline destructive banner, and the parent closes them only `if (ok)`. The refund case was the worst silent-failure in this flow — a failed write previously closed the dialog as if the refund had been recorded, with the error stranded behind the just-closed modal. `changeStatus()` now returns `Promise<boolean>`; callers that ignore it (bulk confirm/cancel, `ReservationRow.onChangeStatus`) are unaffected. Both dialogs are conditionally mounted (`{cancelling && …}` / `{refunding && …}`) so `submitted` resets on remount — no effect needed. (2) **Timestamp-clobber fix** — MiMo's P2 #1 plus a broader case it missed: the quick-refund path routed through `changeStatus(refunding.id, refunding.status, …)`, which re-stamps the status timestamp of an already-terminal reservation to *now* — `cancelled_at` (MiMo) **and** `returned_at` / `picked_up_at` (missed). A quick refund isn't a status transition, so it now calls `update()` directly, which stamps no timestamps; one-line call swap, more semantically honest. (3) **`!saving` backdrop/escape guard** (MiMo's P2 #2) added to the Cancel, Edit, and Create dialogs to match `QuickRefundDialog`. Without it a mid-save backdrop click dismisses the dialog and discards the just-added error banner, re-opening the data-loss hole the whole slice closes. Create's dialog passes `onOpenChange` straight to the parent state setter, so its guard wraps only the backdrop path (`if (!o && saving) return`) — the programmatic post-success `onOpenChange(false)` still fires. Advisor: MiMo shipped-verify run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T05-14-22-verify-the-shipped-close-on-failure-fix-extension-to-the-can-mimo.md` (confirmed the close-on-failure logic correct; raised the two P2s now fixed). - **Car-rental checkout/pickup — financial-safety + close-on-failure fix** (`src/components/admin/store/car-rental/CarRentalCheckoutSection.tsx`) — same audit vein as the reservation-dialog slices, highest-stakes yet. `CheckoutDialog.onConfirm` transitions a reservation to `picked_up` via the hook's `update()` (returns `Promise<boolean>`) and then, if a Stripe PI is on file, invokes `capture-car-rental-balance` to charge the customer's outstanding balance off-session. **The bug (P0):** `onConfirm` discarded `update()`'s boolean — so if the pickup write FAILED (optimistic rollback → false) the code still (a) fired the balance capture against a reservation left `pending`/`confirmed` with no `picked_up` record — *real money off the customer's card with no matching state transition* — and (b) `setActive(null)` closed the dialog, discarding all the operator's captured inspection / odometer / fuel / deposit data, with zero feedback (the hook's `error` was not even destructured). Fix: capture `const ok = await update(...)` and `if (!ok) return;` **before** the Stripe invoke and **before** the close, so a failed pickup neither charges nor closes; destructured `error` and passed it into `CheckoutDialog`, which now renders an inline destructive banner gated by a local `submitted` flag (set on confirm-click; the dialog is conditionally mounted via `{active && …}` so it remounts per open and `submitted` resets — no stale error flashes); added the `!saving` backdrop/escape guard + `disabled={saving}` on Cancel so the operator can't dismiss mid-write and lose the error. Happy path unchanged (capture fires exactly once, non-blocking toast, then closes). Advisors **converged**: DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP — engaged cleanly this time) returned FAIL/FAIL/FAIL on all three with identical minimal fixes; MiMo review run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T05-22-46-workflow-correctness-review-of-a-car-rental-merchant-checkou-mimo.md` rated #1 **P0** ("can charge a customer's card without a pickup record"); MiMo shipped-verify run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T05-26-34-shipped-verification-i-just-applied-the-close-on-failure-fin-mimo.md` returned **ALL PASS** (close-on-failure, submitted-gated banner, dismiss guards, happy path, no TS/logic regression). Deferred (MiMo P2, pre-existing): the odometer prefetch uses `useState(() => { …async… })` as a mount side-effect (double-fires under StrictMode dev) — a `useEffect` cleanup left for when that block is next touched, out of scope for this financial-safety pass. Verified `npm run update` green + `npx eslint` clean. No live Supabase/Stripe calls fired. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Car-rental returns/check-in — silent-failure + dismiss-guard fix** (`src/components/admin/store/car-rental/CarRentalReturnsSection.tsx`) — the dropoff/settlement counterpart to checkout (records end odometer/fuel/damage, computes over-mileage + refuel + late fees, optionally refunds the held deposit via the `refund-car-rental-deposit` edge function, transitions to `returned`). Unlike the reservations flow this section uses **local state + a direct `supabase.update()`**, not the shared hook. It was already safe on the *financial* axis — a failed return write does NOT close the dialog and does NOT fire the deposit refund (the refund block sits after the error guard) — but it was a **silent no-op**: the `err` branch only `console.error`'d and returned, surfacing nothing to the operator (the section's only error UI is a card banner that sits *behind* the open modal). Fix: added a dedicated parent `actionError` state (kept separate from the list-load `error` so realtime reloads can't clobber it), set in the err branch and cleared on entry + on close, passed into `ReturnDialog` as an inline destructive banner gated by a local `submitted` flag — same shape as the other car-rental dialogs. Also added the `!saving` backdrop/escape guard + `disabled={saving}` Cancel: MiMo flagged that without it the operator could dismiss mid-write, reopen the still-`picked_up` rental, and re-submit — a **duplicate deposit-refund window** before the webhook sets `stripe_refund_id`. (#5, P2) the `} as never)` cast on the update payload disables column type-checking — but those columns (`damage_photos` / `damage_marks`) are likely absent from the generated Supabase types (the reason for the cast), so "fixing" it risks a type-error cascade; left until the types are regenerated. (#6, P2) post-unmount `setSaving(false)` — mitigated by the new dismiss guard. (P2, verify) no `key={rental.id}` on `ReturnDialog` — practically unreachable given the modal overlay; left for consistency with the other keyless dialogs. **Also hardened this pass:** `CarRentalWalkInDialog.tsx` — audited and found already close-on-failure-correct (stays open on insert error, renders an inline error banner, double-submit-guarded); added only the missing `!saving` backdrop guard + `disabled={saving}` Cancel for consistency (no advisor round-trip — verified-good by direct read). - **Car-rental customer self-service — TOCTOU stale-status clobber fix** (`src/pages/car-rental/PublicCarRentalBookingDetailPage.tsx`) — the **customer-facing** counterpart to the merchant car-rental slices, reached via a long-lived emailed/SMS link (`/car-rental-booking/:code`). The renter can self-**cancel** (`status:"cancelled"`) and self-**reschedule** (rewrites `pickup_at`/`dropoff_at`/`rental_days`/`base_total_cents`/`total_cents`). Unlike the merchant dialogs this page was **already correct on the close-on-failure axis** — both handlers `toast.error` + keep the dialog open on write error, guard the backdrop with `!cancelling`/`!rescheduling`, and disable their buttons while saving — so no banner/guard work was needed. **The real bug (P0, TOCTOU):** both `.update()` calls filtered only on `.eq("id", r.id)` with **no status guard**, and `r` is a snapshot from the last `lookup()` that can be stale (link left open for hours, a second tab, or the merchant moved the booking on after load). A customer could therefore **silently cancel a car that's already `picked_up`/`returned`, or reschedule a car that's already out** — and because no row-count was checked, the UI reported success either way. The client-side visibility gates (cancel button only for `pending`/`confirmed`, reschedule only >24h out) are computed on that same stale `r`, so they don't protect the write. Fix (additive, no happy-path change, no migration): both writes now append `.in("status", ["pending", "confirmed"]).select("id")`, and after the `err` guard a new branch — `if (!data || data.length === 0)` → toast "This booking can no longer be cancelled/changed online. Please contact the rental team." + close the dialog + re-`lookup()` the true state + `return` — sits **before** the success toast, so a no-op write can never report success. Under RLS, `update().in().select()` returns `[]` (not an error) when the row no longer qualifies, which is exactly the signal used. Advisors **converged on P0 with the identical fix**: DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP — engaged cleanly) and MiMo review `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T05-41-26-workflow-correctness-review-of-the-customer-facing-car-renta-mimo.md` both proposed the exact `.in().select()` + 0-row guard; MiMo shipped-verify `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T05-43-51-shipped-verification-pass-i-applied-your-p0-toctou-fix-to-pu-mimo.md` returned **ALL PASS** (5/5: branch ordering, no dangling destructure, status narrowing, no double-close/lookup, `.select("id")` TS typing clean). **Deferred (owner to decide):** (1) reschedule recomputes `total = base + addons + insurance + taxes + fees − discount` holding `taxes_cents`/`fees_cents` **constant** while `base_total` scales with the new day count — MiMo judged this **acceptable by-design** if taxes/fees are flat per-booking surcharges (DeepSeek rated it P1 if they're percentage-based); either way it's a billing-model decision best fixed via a server-side reschedule RPC, not a blind client edit, so left untouched. (2) The 24h-minimum-pickup rule and the new status gate are still **client-only**; DeepSeek flags that real enforcement belongs in a DB trigger / RLS check (`pickup_at >= now() + 24h`, status-transition guard) — noted for the owner since I can't apply migrations (production-guarded). Sibling `MyCarRentalsPage.tsx` audited — read-only on reservations (`.select()` only, no mutations), nothing to fix. Verified `npm run update` green (type-check + worker + build + PWA) + `npx eslint` clean (1 pre-existing unused-`eslint-disable` warning on the `lookup` `useEffect`, untouched). No live Supabase/Stripe calls fired. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

Advisors: DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP) cross-checked; MiMo shipped-verify run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T06-25-21-shipped-verification-of-a-close-on-failure-fix-in-carrentall-mimo.md` confirmed **all six close-on-failure invariants PASS** (no unconditional close on add/edit/delete, `submitted` reset at every open path, dismiss/double-submit blocked, `is_default` handling client-neutral, mobile-visible actions), flagging only three pre-existing **P2 a11y** nits (icon-only buttons missing `aria-label`, 28px touch targets, `Label` not associated to `Input` via `htmlFor`/`id`) — left for a consistent module-wide a11y sweep rather than churned per-slice. Verified `npm run update` green + `npx eslint` clean on both files. No live Supabase calls fired. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Car-rental reviews — silent-mutation-failure fix (publish / reply / acknowledge / delete)** (`src/components/admin/store/car-rental/CarRentalReviewsSection.tsx` + `src/hooks/car-rental/useCarRentalReviews.ts`) — the **public-review manager** (operator publishes/hides customer reviews on the storefront, posts a public reply, marks reviews read, deletes). Unlike the dialog slices the headline defect here was a **silent optimistic-write failure**: `togglePublished()` flipped `is_published` optimistically with **no rollback and no error** — a failed publish/hide left the admin UI showing the new state while the storefront stayed on the old one, i.e. the operator believes a review is hidden (or live) when it isn't (a **public-storefront-visibility** lie). The other mutations returned `void` so callers couldn't gate on success. Fix (additive, happy path unchanged): hook `togglePublished()`/`replyTo()`/`remove()` now return `Promise<boolean>` and **roll back optimistic state on failure** (`setReviews(prev)`) with a specific `setError(...)`; `replyTo()` uses await-load-then-setError ordering and preserves the draft text + keeps the reply dialog open on failure; `create()` gained `setError(null)` at entry. Section gained a `submitted` flag (reset on reply-open + the delete trigger), `submitReply()`/delete close only `if (ok)`, and both the reply Dialog and delete Dialog got the `!saving` dismiss guard + `{submitted && error}` inline banner + `disabled={saving}` Cancel/confirm (spinner); `togglePublished` + `acknowledge` are inline (non-dialog) buttons whose failures surface via the always-visible card-level error banner. Advisors: DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP) cross-checked the rollback shape; MiMo shipped-verify run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T06-34-18-shipped-verification-of-a-close-on-failure-silent-mutation-f-mimo.md` confirmed **no remaining false-success path** (`togglePublished`/`replyTo`/`remove` all roll back + surface errors; storefront `is_published` correctly snaps back) **but caught a real silent hole I'd missed in `acknowledge()`** ("Mark as read"): it rolled back on failure with **no `setError`** (silent snap-back, zero feedback), didn't clear stale error on entry, and its raw `<button>` had no double-submit guard. Fixed all three — `acknowledge()` now `setSaving(true)` + `setError(null)` at entry, `setReviews(prev)` + `setError("Couldn't mark as read — please retry.")` on failure, `setSaving(false)` always reached; the button gained `disabled={saving}` (+ `disabled:opacity-50`). MiMo **re-verify** run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T06-38-43-re-verification-of-the-acknowledge-fix-in-the-car-rental-rev-mimo.md` returned **all three resolved, no new regressions, "The code is solid."** Verified `npm run update` green (type-check + worker + build + PWA) + `npx eslint` clean on both files. No live Supabase calls fired. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Car-rental settings — misleading-success fix (tax/refund-tier financial config)** (`src/components/admin/store/car-rental/CarRentalSettingsCard.tsx` + `src/hooks/car-rental/useCarRentalSettings.ts`) — the **inline rental-settings card** (not a dialog) where the operator sets the store's **financial config**: tax rate (stored as bps) + label, currency, no-show / late-return grace hours, auto-confirm-online-bookings toggle, the customer-facing cancellation policy, and the **refund-tier ladder** that drives every cancellation refund. Distinct from the dialog slices: this card had a **misleading-success** defect — `submit()` called `await save(draft)` then **unconditionally** cleared the `dirty` flag and flashed the green "Saved" pill **even when the write failed**, so on failure the operator saw a false "Saved" sitting next to the real red error banner *and* the "Save changes" retry button vanished (because it's gated on `dirty`) — i.e. the operator walks away believing a new tax rate or refund ladder persisted when it didn't, a direct **bookkeeping/refund-math** hazard. Fix (additive, happy path unchanged): hook `save()` changed from returning `void` to `Promise<boolean>` (false on `!storeId` and on the Supabase error branch, true after `setSettings(data.settings)`); `submit()` now gates on `const ok = await save(draft); if (!ok) return;` **before** clearing `dirty` / flashing "Saved" — so a failed save keeps `dirty` true (retry button stays), shows no false flash, surfaces the error banner, and preserves the typed draft (tax rate, refund tiers). Advisors: DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP) cross-checked the gate ordering; MiMo shipped-verify run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T06-32-06-shipped-verification-of-a-misleading-success-fix-in-the-car--mimo.md` confirmed **the core misleading-success fix is solid** ("Core fix is solid") — no false success path remains. MiMo's remaining notes are pre-existing and deferred to the consistent module-wide sweep: a **P2 stale-error-banner** (the `Couldn't save settings.` message lingers across subsequent edits until the next save — the same latent-banner cosmetic noted on the dialog slices) plus three **a11y/responsive P2s** (`Field` `Label` not associated to inputs via `htmlFor`/`id`; refund-tier inputs lack `aria-label`; the tier row can overflow below ~360px without `flex-wrap`). Verified `npm run update` green (type-check + worker + build + PWA) + `npx eslint` clean on both files. No live Supabase calls fired. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

- **Car-rental rates — close-on-failure fix + null-mileage data-corruption fix (inline rate-cell editor)** (`src/components/admin/store/car-rental/CarRentalRatesSection.tsx`) — the fleet-wide **rate editor** (operator click-to-edits daily/weekly/monthly rates, mileage limit, extra-mile, and security deposit per vehicle without opening each one). Backed by `useCarRentalVehicles.update` (already `Promise<boolean>` + rollback from the Fleet slice). **Close-on-failure defect:** `commitEdit()` called `await update(...)` then **unconditionally** `setEditingCell(null)`, so a failed rate write closed the inline editor and discarded the operator's typed value (the hook's rollback reverted the cell to the old number, with the failure stranded only in the card-level banner) — a silent **pricing** miss. Fix: `commitEdit()` now guards entry with `if (!editingCell || saving) return;` (blocks Enter double-submit) and gates the close on success — `const ok = await update(...); if (ok) setEditingCell(null);` — so on failure the editor stays open with the typed value for retry (Enter) or cancel (Esc/X). Advisors: DeepSeek (`deepseek-reasoner` via MCP) cross-checked; MiMo shipped-verify run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T06-39-19-shipped-verification-of-a-close-on-failure-fix-in-the-car-re-mimo.md` confirmed the close-on-failure fix is properly wired **and surfaced two genuine pre-existing bugs in the same editor**: (P0) `const current = v[field] ?? 0` coerced a `null` `mileage_limit_per_day` (= unlimited) to `0` **before** the "Unlimited" formatter, so unlimited mileage rendered as "0" and a no-op Enter overwrote `null` → `0` miles/day (**data corruption** — 0 ≠ unlimited); (P1) a race where starting to edit cell B while cell A's save was in-flight let A's success `setEditingCell(null)` nuke B's editor + draft. Fixed both: `startEdit` now reads `const current = v[field]` (no `?? 0` coercion) and pre-fills mileage as `current == null ? "" : String(current)` so blank round-trips back to `null`/unlimited on commit, and gained `if (saving) return;` to block opening a new cell mid-save (closes the race without a ref); `RateCell` display reads `v[field]` and routes `null` through the formatter (→ "Unlimited") with a `current == null || current === 0` empty-branch for money fields. MiMo **re-verify** run `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T06-45-03-re-verification-of-two-bug-fixes-in-the-car-rental-rates-inl-mimo.md` returned **"No remaining real bugs. The code is solid."** (null↔"" round-trip clean, race guard closed, money math intact). Browser-verification of the null-mileage path was not run (it needs an authed store-owner session with a seeded unlimited-mileage vehicle, which this env can't reach without firing live auth) — relied on the tsc build gate + advisor logic re-verify. Verified `npm run update` green + `npx eslint` clean. No live Supabase calls fired. Ready for owner to commit. — @claude, 2026-06-16

This is an **auto-repair** document whose line items include **part numbers** (long, hyphenated/space-free tokens), so the overflow risk is real for this domain; `overflow-x-auto` lets the table scroll instead of bleeding off-screen, and shows **no scrollbar unless content actually overflows** (zero cost for normal invoices). `print:overflow-visible` preserves print/PDF fidelity (the browser paginates naturally — no clipping on the printed page). **Flagged fetched-but-unused field** — `Resolved.expires_at` is typed + returned by the RPC but **never read on the client** (expiry is enforced **server-side** in the `get_shared_document` security-definer RPC); it's a structural return-type artifact, **skipped** (removing it would require an RPC change — HARD-RULE-protected). Took **MiMo's add** because (a) DeepSeek's rationale is technically off — `overflow-x-auto` renders **no** scrollbar unless overflow actually occurs, so it is *not* visual noise; (b) the auto-repair part-number domain makes the overflow genuinely possible; and (c) I neutralized the only real downside (this is a print-critical financial document) with `print:overflow-visible`, which neither advisor proposed. **Verified** `npm run update` green (**true exit 0, unpiped** — type-check + worker type-check both pass since the build only runs on `&&`; `✓ built in 7.77s`; `dist/sw.js` freshly generated + PWA precache 18 entries (2550.89 KiB) emitted). _Preview caveat: the populated document is gated behind a valid, unexpired share token + a populated `store_profiles` row (empty local DB → the reachable state is the "Link unavailable" expired/revoked card, which has no interactive controls), so rendering the invoice table needs a real token; per the established preview-contention protocol (shared dev server contended by parallel agents) I relied on the green gate + the clean 1/1 className-only diff + the well-established Tailwind `overflow-x-auto` responsive-table pattern (no new token semantics introduced)._ — @claude, 2026-06-13

 - **Chat security — link trust-boundary hardening** — ✅ **COMPLETE** (owner pivot from UI redesign "for safety"; focus = chat & messaging). `src/components/chat/ChatMessageBubble.tsx`: the LinkPreviewCard `isInternalLink` check used substring matching (`hostname.includes("lovable")`/`.includes("hizovo")`), which trusts attacker-controlled hosts (`lovable.attacker.com`, `hizovo.attacker.com`, `evil-lovable.com`, `hizovo.com.evil.com`) → they skipped the `ExternalLinkWarning` safety dialog and got silently in-app `navigate()`'d to an attacker-chosen path. Empirically reproduced via node (9 host cases). Fix: exact/suffix host match against `["lovable.app","hizovo.com"]` (`host === h || host.endsWith("."+h)`) + current-origin + an http(s)-only protocol guard. Repo's own canonical domain IS `hizovo.com` (theme key, support email, footer socials, generated sound links) — deliberately NOT renamed. BOTH advisors ran this slice: DeepSeek `deepseek-chat` (MCP) + MiMo `mimo-v2.5-pro` (see `docs/agent-runs/2026-06-16T20-45-45-*-mimo.md`); both independently confirmed the weakness + endorsed the suffix fix.
